title: Toward automated severe pharyngitis detection with smartphone camera using deep learning networks
summary: CycleGAN-generated images augmented a 339-image throat dataset for transfer-learned classifiers; ResNet50 achieved test ROC-AUC 0.988 and four-fold ROC-AUC 0.992 for severe pharyngitis detection. The small image set limits generalization, and clinical benefit was not tested.
ai_technology: CycleGAN generates training images for transfer-learned ResNet50, Inception-v3 and MobileNet-v2 throat-image classifiers.
